title: Sales Journey
prompt:
Refine this LeadGenBureau Sales Journey website comp. Preserve its navigation, centered headline "Клиент найден. История только начинается.", "Обсудить задачу" CTA, clear burgundy/pale cool silver color system, four numbered stations "Спрос", "Разговор", "Риск", "Следующий шаг", central fictional client dossier, previous voice conversation slip, manual controls, demo label and the lower NeuroROP continuation.

Change the imagery and framing decisively: remove ALL city skylines, roads through scenery, forests, mountains, buildings, water, landscapes, human photographs and stock businessmen. They are unrelated to the sales process. The background must be a clean flat pale silver-lilac designed website surface with a broad matte burgundy scene area at the base. Convert the route into a refined crisp two-dimensional functional wayfinding line, connecting four legible chapters at deliberately varied heights. No glow, no gradient, no 3D render and no horizon. The key visual subject is the ONE client dossier, not a destination landscape. Give the current large white dossier exceptional hierarchy: "Компания Север", "КП на согласовании", "Не назначен следующий контакт", "Уточнить дату решения". The small conversation slip states "Потребность актуальна". End state is an agreed next step, not an automatic sale.

Recompose the lower continuation to use a precise typographic line "Менеджер понимает, что делать дальше." and a compact meaningful demonstration of an assigned task with "NeuroROP — пилот"; no person image. Maintain generous whitespace, no repetitive card grid and no unnecessary metric visuals. The scene must look like a usable premium website based on sequential business information, not a dashboard, infographic poster, tourism site or editorial photo. No new invented commercial claims or brand assets. Keep all Russian wording accurate, visibly mark "Демо · данные вымышлены", and show one coherent first viewport plus continuation at the same 3:2 landscape framing.
initialPrompt:
Create one high-fidelity desktop WEBSITE DESIGN COMP for LeadGenBureau, a Russian B2B sales automation agency with its own products. Candidate B, Sales Journey, must be a radically different website composition from a product dashboard hero. Output one landscape 3:2 raster, frontal website surface, no device frame, browser chrome or comparison collage. Show the first viewport and continuation into one customer-journey scene, with a coherent usable site frame.

STRUCTURE: quiet slim top navigation with wordmark "LeadGenBureau" left, "Путь клиента" and "Решения", primary button "Обсудить задачу" right. The opening is a centered monumental but finely set Cyrillic headline occupying the upper third: "Клиент найден. / История только начинается." Short centered explanatory sentence underneath "От сигнала спроса до следующего действия в сделке." Then CTA "Обсудить задачу" and a quieter text link "Пройти путь клиента". Across the middle and lower viewport, the protagonist is ONE oversized horizontal sales dossier moving through a real narrative, shown at its current third stage. A continuous bent route with four purposeful stations goes behind and around the dossier; stations are labeled "Спрос", "Разговор", "Риск", "Следующий шаг", current stage "Риск" in a solid burgundy circle. The lower center dossier is a large crisp light rectangle holding "Компания Север", "КП на согласовании", an actual concern "Не назначен следующий контакт", and the next intervention "Уточнить дату решения". A smaller adjacent voice conversation slip is visibly the previous event, with the short line "Потребность актуальна". Controls are manual previous/next, four visibly interactive chapter marks, no automatic-sale endpoint. Mark the scene clearly "Демо · данные вымышлены". At the bottom show enough continuation to prove a story: "Менеджер понимает, что делать дальше." with a restrained "NeuroROP — пилот" label.

ART DIRECTION: a contemporary information journey drawing on elegant transport wayfinding and cinematic story sequencing, not a paper scrapbook or SaaS dashboard. Pale cool silver/lilac ground, deep burgundy structural band, strong ink and white areas; saturated burgundy owns the progression and one broad scene region, not tiny coral accents on cream. One continuous legible route is the focal element; deliberately spacious centered typographic opening, with a subtly offset hero dossier and clearly numbered real steps only where sequence matters. Expressive but clean humanist Cyrillic sans display and exact readable navigation. Fine geometric connectors, authentic wayfinding proportions, carefully composed editorial rhythm without serif italics, kraft paper or scribbled arrows. A feeling of anticipation and progress; clear commercial invitation remains visible. The typography, buttons and manual stage indicators follow one cohesive story language.

CONTENT RULES: Russian copy exact, concise and legible. Only fictional company "Компания Север" and synthetic demo content. Product status: lead generation working, voice qualification MVP, NeuroROP pilot, no automatic sale or invented ROI, no fake endorsements, metrics or customer logos. No generic robot imagery, sci-fi neon, gradient text, glassmorphism, floating spheres, 3D mascots, decorative stock graphs, same-size card grids or tiny uppercase eyebrow slogans. The narrative helps a business owner understand handoffs and next action; it must be a real persuasive website comp rather than a poster.
